title: Odell Beckham Jr Gets Kicked Off Flight
description:
► CF Moto
https://tribelink.co/CodeBlueCam/CFMOTO

On November 27, 2022, officers were dispatched to a medical emergency at the Miami International Airport. The flight crew attempted to wake up 30-year-old Odell Beckham Jr to fasten his seatbelt but he appeared to be coming in and out of consciousness. When he was asked to leave the plane he refused, causing everyone else to deplane. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
